jobs.title: Implementation Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting career opportunity available as an Implementation Enablement Specialist. This position will be remote based. The Full Time schedule for this role will be 8 AM\-5 PM, Monday\-Friday with flexibility as needed.
**Job Summary**  

The Implementation Enablement Specialist is responsible for the documentation, standardization, and continuous improvement of the processes used by the Implementation team. This position partners directly with the VP of Implementations to advance department\-wide initiatives, support technology build\-outs, and maintain consistent operating standards across every stage of the implementation lifecycle. This role designs and maintains workflow automations, owns the standardization of client data to ElevatePFS data values, and develops the reporting that gives implementation leadership visibility into capacity, go\-live progress, and delivery quality. The position is internal facing and requires strong prioritization skills, advanced proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and SharePoint, experience with monday.com, and familiarity with AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  

* Build, standardize, and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and templates across all service lines and each stage of the implementation lifecycle.
* Define and document cross\-team handoffs and go\-live readiness standards so that all teams operate from a consistent understanding of the process.
* Maintain a single, current source of truth for implementation processes and reference materials.
* Own the standardization of client data points to ElevatePFS standard data values, and build and maintain the automations that support that mapping.
* Design and maintain workflow automations, including monday.com boards and automations, file routing, and reconciliations, that reduce manual effort for the delivery teams.
* Evaluate repetitive, manual tasks across the department and determine which should be converted into documented, automated processes.
* Design and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting covering pipeline\-to\-capacity, go\-live and transition tracking, and quality and training trends.
* Analyze trends and surface risks or bottlenecks to implementation leadership with clear, decision\-ready recommendations.
* Translate delivery team pain points into concrete process, tooling, or automation improvements and coordinate their rollout.
* Develop onboarding materials and internal reference documentation to support the enablement of new implementers.
* Lead recurring reviews of implementation processes to identify and eliminate inefficiencies.
* Prioritize improvement initiatives by business impact and manage them from concept through documented, adopted change.
* Administer the EPIC access agreement process company\-wide, from submission through documentation retention, and recommend improvements to that workflow.
* Own the high\-level monday.com boards that support department reporting and data analysis.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications and Requirements**  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
* Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
* Three or more years of experience in process improvement, operations, business or data analysis, or implementation and project support; healthcare revenue cycle management or a related field preferred.
* Demonstrated experience documenting processes and developing SOPs, playbooks, or operating standards.
* Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to build reports and dashboards and translate data into clear, actionable insight.
* Experience with workflow and automation tooling such as monday.com or Power Automate, with a demonstrated record of automating manual work.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and SharePoint; experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude preferred.
* Experience with data mapping, standardization, and cross\-system reconciliation preferred.
* Familiarity with reporting and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, and with light scripting or no\-code automation, preferred.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to influence and coordinate across teams without direct authority.
* Highly organized and self\-directed, with the ability to manage multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously and exercise independent judgment in setting priorities.
* Remote and Hybrid positions require home internet connections that meet the company's upload and download speed criteria.


**Benefits:**
  

ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well\-being of our employees and their families.
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* 401K (100% match for the first 3% \& 50% match for the next 2%)
* 15 days of PTO
* 7 paid Holidays
* 2 Floating holidays
* 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
* Pet Insurance
* Employee referral bonus program
* Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
* Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles

The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.
The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and Employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change.  

  

**ElevatePFS is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Sales Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


When you’re part of the team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do important work, and you’ll be valued and recognized for your performance. With passionate managers and encouraging coworkers, you’ll find the resources and opportunities to make meaningful contributions to the world.

**Location/Division Specific Information**


The Sr. Technical Sales Training Specialist for the Biosciences Division is responsible for developing and delivering technical sales training, onboarding, and ongoing learning programs aligned with commercial needs and go\-to\-market priorities.


While based in North America, this role develops scalable learning solutions and collaborates with regional partners to support consistent learning experiences across the global commercial organization.

**This position is site\-based in Carlsbad, CA; Grand Island, NY; Austin, TX; Waltham, MA; or Pittsburgh, PA.**

**How you will make an impact**


With the support of product and portfolio owners, you will develop product, workflow, and sales training that translates complex scientific concepts into practical learning experiences for commercial teams.


A key responsibility of this role is the **in\-person delivery of new\-hire onboarding**, including facilitating technical and workflow training, hands\-on learning, practical application exercises, and knowledge assessments. You will help create an engaging onboarding experience that builds the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed for new commercial colleagues to be successful in their roles.


You will partner with Marketing, Product Management, Sales, regional training partners, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, develop scalable training solutions, and maintain relevant and accurate content for commercial teams globally.


This is a highly visible individual contributor role where scientific expertise, facilitation skills, learner engagement, and the ability to translate technical information into effective commercial training are critical to success.

**What you will do**

* Develop, maintain, and deliver technical sales training across product, application, and experimental workflow topics using virtual, digital, and instructor\-led learning approaches.
* **Facilitate in\-person new\-hire onboarding**, including technical instruction, hands\-on learning, practical application, assessments, and activities that build commercial readiness.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and develop training aligned with go\-to\-market strategies, competitive positioning, and customer needs.
* Develop learning content and tools that can be effectively used and scaled across regions, partnering with global training stakeholders to support consistency and localization as needed.
* Evaluate learner knowledge and proficiency and use feedback and assessment results to continuously improve training content and delivery.
* Maintain and update existing training materials to ensure scientific accuracy, commercial relevance, and consistency.
* Support commercial meetings, sales meetings, and other learning events through technical training, facilitation, and learner engagement.

**How you will get there?**

**Education Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in biology or a related biological sciences field required.
* Master’s degree or Ph.D. in life sciences highly preferred due to the technical science requirements to succeed in this role.

**Experience**

* 5\+ years of relevant life sciences experience, with at least 2 years in technical training, sales training, commercial enablement, L\&D, or a related function preferred.
* Experience developing and delivering technical training for commercial or sales audiences, including instructor\-led and virtual learning.
* Experience facilitating **in\-person training, onboarding, workshops, or hands\-on learning experiences**.
* Practical laboratory experience in life sciences with the ability to understand and communicate complex scientific concepts.
* Previous field, commercial, or sales experience preferred, with an understanding of professional selling skills, customer needs, and commercial workflows.
* Experience developing learning content using instructional design principles and digital learning tools.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional and geographically dispersed teams; experience supporting global learning programs preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Strong instructor\-led facilitation and presentation skills with the ability to engage diverse commercial audiences in both in\-person and virtual environments.
* Ability to translate complex scientific and technical concepts into clear, practical, and commercially relevant learning experiences.
* Strong understanding of laboratory and experimental biological sciences.
* Understanding of commercial sales organizations and the ability to connect technical learning to customer needs, product positioning, and sales execution.
* Strong interpersonal, written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Marketing, Sales, and regional teams in a global, matrixed organization.
* Ability to manage changing priorities and independently develop solutions when challenges or barriers arise.
* Experience with eLearning tools, instructional design, scriptwriting, video, and other digital learning approaches.
* **Willingness to travel internationally up to 15% to support in\-person onboarding, commercial meetings, training programs, and other business needs**

**Compensation and Benefits**


The salary range estimated for this position based in Texas is $93,800\.00–$125,000\.00\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount


For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total\-rewards

jobs.title: EHR Systems Analyst & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Damien Center \| Health Operations \| Indianapolis, IN
  
  

Full\-Time \| Salaried, Exempt \| $70,000
  
  

Are you the person everyone calls when eClinicalWorks won't cooperate? Do you get a little thrill out of turning a clunky workflow into one that just makes sense? And do you want your tech expertise to directly support care for people living with or at risk for HIV?
  
  

If so, we'd love to meet you. Damien Center is looking for an EHR Systems Analyst \& Support Specialist to be the go\-to expert who keeps our electronic health record running smoothly, helps our teams get the most out of it, and makes sure it works as hard for our patients as our people do.
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

Every appointment, care plan, and follow\-up at Damien Center runs through our EHR. When the system works well, our care teams can spend less time clicking and more time connecting with the people they serve. That's where you come in.
  
  

In this role, you'll be both a trusted helpdesk resource and a strategic partner. You'll troubleshoot day\-to\-day issues, yes, but you'll also shape how our integrated care, quality, and operations teams work, making sure our system supports the reporting and standards that come with being a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and a Patient\-Centered Medical Home (PCMH). Your work will have a real, visible impact on patient care.
  
  

About Damien Center
  
  

Founded in 1987, Damien Center is Indiana's oldest and largest AIDS service organization, serving more than 8,000 individuals living with or at risk for HIV. We're a trusted partner offering care coordination, integrated care and pharmacy services, mental health, housing, and nutrition, and we're a safe, welcoming home for anyone seeking care.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
  

Keep Our EHR Running Smoothly
  
  

•
  
Serve as the primary helpdesk resource for eClinicalWorks, troubleshooting issues and resolving user concerns
  
  

•
  
Triage, document, and track support requests through to resolution, and escalate to the vendor when needed
  
  

•
  
Manage user accounts, security roles, and access
  
  

•
  
Configure and maintain templates, forms, order sets, alerts, registries, and other workflow tools
  
  

•
  
Help test and roll out software updates and new functionality
  
  

Be Our FQHC \& PCMH Go\-To
  
  

•
  
Act as the organization's expert on how FQHC and PCMH requirements show up in EHR workflows and documentation
  
  

•
  
Make sure eClinicalWorks supports UDS reporting, quality measures, care coordination, preventive and population health, health equity, patient engagement, enabling services, and care gap management
  
  

•
  
Keep an eye on regulatory changes and recommend system updates to stay ahead of them
  
  

Drive Quality \& Continuous Improvement
  
  

•
  
Oversee maintenance of reporting tools and support UDS and quality reporting
  
  

•
  
Spot trends in support requests and turn them into smarter processes
  
  

•
  
Identify opportunities to optimize workflows and participate in quality improvement initiatives
  
  

Teach, Coach \& Empower
  
  

•
  
Develop and deliver eClinicalWorks training, from group sessions to one\-on\-one coaching
  
  

•
  
Lead EHR onboarding for new team members
  
  

•
  
Oversee educational materials and help build standard operating procedures
  
  

Collaborate \& Lead Projects
  
  

•
  
Partner with integrated care, operations, quality, and leadership teams on workflow enhancements
  
  

•
  
Serve as the liaison between end users and the EHR vendor
  
  

•
  
Participate in system implementations, upgrades, testing, and validation
  
  

What You Bring
  
  

Required
  
  

•
  
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Information Technology, Nursing, Public Health, or a related field\*
  
  

•
  
3\+ years of experience supporting an EHR system in a healthcare setting
  
  

•
  
Hands\-on experience with eClinicalWorks
  
  

•
  
2\+ years of experience in an FQHC, community health center, or primary care environment
  
  

•
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reporting tools, and healthcare technology systems
  
  

Preferred
  
  

•
  
Experience with PCMH principles and requirements
  
  

•
  
Experience with quality reporting, UDS measures, and population health initiatives
  
  

* Work or lived experience may substitute for education requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Who You Are
  
  

•
  
The Translator. You speak both "clinic" and "tech" fluently, and you can explain a system change to a provider, a front desk team member, or a leader in a way that clicks for each of them.
  
  

•
  
The Problem Solver. You enjoy digging into the "why" behind an issue and don't stop at the quick fix when a better solution is within reach.
  
  

•
  
The Patient Teacher. You're comfortable supporting people at every level of tech confidence, and you meet them where they are.
  
  

•
  
The Systems Thinker. You see how one workflow connects to reporting, quality, and ultimately patient care, and you design with the big picture in mind.
  
  

•
  
The Steady Hand. You juggle multiple priorities with organization and calm, work well independently, and handle sensitive information with the highest integrity and confidentiality.
  
  

•
  
The Relationship Builder. You build trust across departments and help create a culture of courtesy, respect, and inclusion.
  
  

Compensation \& Benefits
  
  

**Salary:** $70,000 plus an annual performance\-based salary increase
  
  

•
  
150 hours of PTO in your first year, growing to 195 hours per year after that
  
  

•
  
12 paid holidays
  
  

•
  
Medical coverage with PPO or HDHP options, plus dental and vision
  
  

•
  
HSA or FSA, plus a Dependent Care FSA
  
  

•
  
403(b) retirement plan with 5% match and 100% vesting after 90 days
  
  

•
  
Life insurance at 2x annual salary, plus voluntary life coverage for spouse and children
  
  

•
  
Short\- and long\-term disability
  
  

•
  
Employee Assistance Program and a premium Calm app subscription
  
  

•
  
Tuition assistance and professional development opportunities
  
  

Good to Know
  
  

•
  
This role reports to the Director of IT.
  
  

•
  
This is an office\-based role; remote work may be approved on a case\-by\-case basis.
  
  

•
  
Within your first 90 days, you'll complete four short healthcare IT courses (on us, with certificates provided) covering IT support in healthcare, health IT fundamentals, patient safety, and data security and privacy.
  
  

•
  
As a condition of employment, Damien Center requires an annual flu vaccination and TB test (or chest x\-ray), barring an approved religious or medical exemption.
  
  

Ready to Make an Impact?
  
  

If you're excited about using your EHR expertise to help a mission\-driven team deliver outstanding care, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, EHR & PMS Integrations
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
================


Liine is a fast\-growing software startup based in downtown Raleigh, NC. Our AI\-powered call tracking, marketing analytics and ad optimization platform helps specialty healthcare and dental practices convert more new patient inquiries into appointments. With over $10M in ARR and winner of the 2026 Triangle Business Journal's 50 Best Places to Work, we are on our way to making Liine a core component of every healthcare practice's technology stack.

  

More about Liine (click links to view)


Read our case studies


Read our customer reviews


Startups in Raleigh You Need to Know in 2025


19 Raleigh Startups Making the City a Top Tech Destination


Liine named as a Call Recording FrontRunner by SoftwareAdvice


Liine named to Capterra's Shortlist for Call Recording


Liine named an AI "Category Leader" by GetApp


Liine Glassdoor Reviews

**About the team:**
-------------------


You will be joining our Healthcare Data Integrations team to help build how patient, appointment, and revenue data gets into Liine. Team responsibilities include:

**Direct EHR/PMS integrations** — designing and standing up direct connections to systems like ModMed, NextGen, Open Dental, WinOMS/Carestream, and others.

**Bespoke MROI audits and ingestion** — profiling raw sample data from partner data sources, proving feasibility, and building the ingestion that powers MROI reporting.

**Aggregator program management** — project\-managing integrations that run through third\-party data aggregators, and holding those partners accountable to data quality standards.

**Build vs. buy evaluation** — assessing integration decisions over time based on data quality, cost, and control considerations.

  

This is a relatively new mandate at Liine, so the team has unusual room to shape its own tooling, standards, and playbooks.

  

**The role:**
-------------


As the team's Data Scientist, you are the person who looks at a brand\-new pile of healthcare data and figures out whether — and how — it can be trusted to drive revenue reporting. You will sit at the intersection of raw vendor data and the Liine MROI product, profiling incoming data, diagnosing quality problems, defining the mappings and transformations that normalize it, and validating that what lands in our dashboards is correct.

  

You will work hands\-on every day in SQL and Python, partner closely with the Integration Software Engineer who builds the production pipelines, and act as Liine's technical counterpart


to the data analysts and engineers on the vendor and aggregator side. This is a deep individual contributor role for someone who is energized by messy, real\-world healthcare data and takes pride in getting it right.

  

Our top priorities for this role are data accuracy and security. You will be working with data used to drive millions of dollars of decisions — accuracy and transparency are essential. You will also be handling data protected under HIPAA, which must always be kept private and secure. Security is not an afterthought at Liine, and all candidates should seriously consider the


responsibility that comes with this role.

  

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* **Audit new data sources for MROI readiness.** Profile EHR, PMS, and partner data\-lake exports for completeness, key coverage, linkage, and revenue\-reporting feasibility, then deliver a clear go / conditional\-go / no\-go recommendation.
* **Diagnose and resolve data\-quality blockers.** Identify the specific issues that break reporting, such as missing encounter IDs, incomplete charge fields, weak patient matching, or absent creation dates, and convert them into precise requests for vendors or aggregators.
* **Define normalization and mapping logic.** Map vendor schemas to Liine's data model and design transformations such as collapsing inconsistent, EMR\-specific appointment statuses into stable FHIR\-style buckets that hold up across many source systems.
* **Partner on production ingestion.** Work with the Integration Software Engineer to turn validated mappings into repeatable pipelines, including file\-based and data\-lake handoffs.
* **Own ongoing data quality.** Build monitoring, reconciliation, and drift\-detection checks that keep MROI reporting accurate after go\-live.
* **Build the team's tooling and standards.** Help turn repeated audit work into reusable tooling, templates, and eventually more automated auditing, so each successive integration is faster than the last.
* **Support build vs. buy decisions.** Help assess integration options as the program scales, weighing data quality, cost, and control against partnership and aggregator alternatives.

**What you'll bring:**
----------------------

* **5–7 years with production data.** You have worked in data science, data engineering, data quality, or analytics engineering roles where imperfect real\-world data directly affects business decisions.
* **Strong SQL and Python.** You are fluent in SQL and comfortable using Python, including pandas or equivalent tools, for profiling, validation, and transformation work every day.
* **Healthcare data\-quality judgment.** You can reason about null rates, key coverage, record linkage, and downstream reporting risk, especially in patient, appointment, encounter, and charge data.
* **Comfort with relational data modeling.** You understand entity relationships and joins deeply and can reason about how dimensions and facts (patients, appointments, encounters, charges) should link.
* **ETL and ingestion experience.** You have built or closely supported pipelines involving file\-based, warehouse, or data\-lake handoffs such as CSV, S3, Snowflake, or similar systems.
* **Clear written and verbal communication.** You can explain a data problem precisely enough that a vendor's engineer knows exactly what to fix and summarize an audit so a product leader can make a call.
* **Ownership and rigor.** You are comfortable being accountable for whether the numbers are right and communicating issues clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Experience with healthcare data — EHR/PMS systems, clinical or claims/charge data, or FHIR\-based models.
* Familiarity with specific systems in our world: ModMed, NextGen, Open Dental, WinOMS / Carestream, eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, or Athena.
* Experience working through healthcare data aggregators or middleware platforms.
* Working knowledge of PHI/HIPAA handling, BAAs, and secure data exchange.
* Snowflake and AWS (S3, IAM) familiarity, including storage\-integration patterns between a partner's warehouse and your buckets.
* Exposure to marketing\-attribution or revenue/ROI analytics.
* Interest in building internal tooling and pushing toward more automated, repeatable data audits.

**How you'll work:**
--------------------


You will report to the Healthcare Data Integrations Team Lead and work in close, day\-to\-day partnership with the team's Integration Software Engineer. The role also carries a strong dotted\-line relationship to Liine's Director of Engineering, who sets technical standards and helps guide the more architectural calls. You will collaborate regularly with Product, Implementation, and Customer Operations, and you will be Liine's hands\-on technical point of contact with our integration and aggregator partners.

  

**Perks and benefits include:**
-------------------------------

* Competitive base salary
* Generous equity package
* 4% 401K contribution match
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Short and long\-term disability insurance
* Unlimited PTO

**Additional Information:**
---------------------------


Candidates who can work out of our downtown Raleigh office are preferred, but we will also consider exceptional remote applications. We work from our downtown Raleigh office on


Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, with the option to work remotely on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

  

We’re building something special and are looking for great people to join our team!

 **Why Join Us:**


Ventura Foods innovates and manufactures food solutions for foodservice and retail businesses. We make exclusive products for the world's most iconic restaurants and retailers, we provide ready\-to\-go product solutions for professional kitchens, and we make consumer brands everyone knows and loves. When you work for Ventura Foods, you get a strong foundation of training, a manager who cares about you and celebrates your success, a safe environment, and challenging work. As part of our team, your future is limited only by how much you’re willing to push yourself to get there. We invest in your growth because you invest in ours.

Ventura Foods reserves the right to pay outside of the given range based on a variety of factors including but not limited to: candidate skills and experience, complexity of the job, budgetary factors, and location/geography. Ventura Foods conducts regular reviews of compensation ranges and therefore reserves the right to alter this range at any given time.

 **Our Culture**  

Our Culture reflects our commitment to treating every employee with respect and creating an environment where people can do their best work. By fostering a workplace that is supportive, collaborative, and grounded in integrity, we continue to attract strong talent and meet the high expectations of a rapidly evolving marketplace.  

  

Ventura Foods is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Role Overview**

**Organization:** Facilitron Inc

**About Us:** Facilitron is a funded, fast\-growing (\#30 in the Financial Times \- America's Fastest Growing Companies in 2021\) startup who partners with schools, colleges and municipalities across the United States to simplify the scheduling and maintenance of public spaces. With over 7\-billion square feet of gyms, athletic fields, auditoriums, classrooms and more available to the public for rent, Facilitron is the leading marketplace for public space rentals. Today, thousands of schools and other public and private facility owners partner with Facilitron to rent and manage their real estate assets.

**Type of work:** Remote

**Salary**: $45K\-$65K based on experience.

**Position**: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist

We are seeking a **Works Implementation Solutions Specialist** to assist our clients through onboarding, technical enablement, and ongoing daily operations. In this role, you will provide hands\-on, high\-touch support to ensure smooth rollouts and stable long\-term platform use.

A background in **Maintenance \& Operations (M\&O)**—ideally with prior experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operational coordinator capacity—is required to understand our clients' physical/operational workflows and maintenance environments. **Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish** is strongly preferred to support our growing multi\-regional account base.

**Key Responsibilities Implementation \& Client Onboarding**

* Support end\-to\-end client implementations, helping configure systems, map workflows, and execute rollout plans under the guidance of project managers.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for operational queries and technical onboarding assistance during the client go\-live phase.
* Deliver bilingual (English/Spanish) training sessions and step\-by\-step documentation to client end\-users and maintenance teams.

**Operational \& Account Support**

* Leverage M\&O experience to understand client workflows, troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, and maintain system readiness.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve daily technical support tickets, escalations, and system configuration requests.
* Monitor account health, track recurring support patterns, and assist in maintaining high service\-level agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to escalate software bugs and advocate for client needs.

**Qualifications \& Skills Required** 

* **M\&O Experience:** 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Maintenance \& Operations (M\&O), preferably with past experience in a supervisory, lead technician, or coordinator role.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfort navigating ticketing systems, task tracking tools, and troubleshooting software configurations.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with a client\-first, detail\-oriented approach to resolving technical issues.

**Preferred**

* **Tech Support \& Onboarding:** Experience working in software implementation, technical support, or account support at a B2B SaaS or technology company.
* **Language Skills:** Professional fluency (verbal and written) in both **English and Spanish**.
* **Education \& Experience:** Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience in operations, technical support, or client management.

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 5% Match
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

* Florida (Required)

jobs.description:
**Position Title**: AI Training Specialist

**Department**: AI Department

**Reports To**: As assigned by Director

 **POSITION SUMMARY**


The Artificial Intelligence (AI) Training Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing a comprehensive training program for staff and supervisors on artificial intelligence (AI),Microsoft Copilot, and related systems. This role ensures that all employees are equipped with the knowledge and skills to use AI tools responsibly and effectively in their daily work, in alignment with organizational policies and evolving technology.

**HOURS**: 8 per Day / 5 Days per Week

**Benefits Package**

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Care Plan
* Life Insurance
* Paid Holidays
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Paid Vacation Time
* Sick Time
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Competitive wages
* Stability and career advancement
* Continuing Education Opportunities

**General Duties**:


1\. Develop and Execute Trainings: Plan and oversee a phased rollout of AI and Copilot training, including policy, responsible use, and application in platforms such as Gemini Notebook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.


2\. Curriculum Design: Create and update training materials for diverse audiences, including staff, supervisors, and specialized teams.


3\. Promote Data Security and Ethical AI Use: Ensure training content and practices reinforce the importance of data privacy, security protocols and ethical use of AI technologies including but not limited to sensitive health information across all data repositories.


4\. Facilitate Training Sessions: Deliver in\-person and virtual training sessions, adapting content for new hires, ongoing staff development, and monthly learning collaboratives.


5\. Ensures a high\-quality standard for all agency staff training by implementing and adhering to learning principles and latest understanding of education and teaching methods.


6\. Support Ongoing Learning: Organize and facilitate monthly learning collaboratives for advanced topics, Q\&A, and updates.


7\. Continuous Improvement: Collect feedback, monitor training effectiveness, and update programs to reflect new technologies, policies, and organizational needs.


8\. Stakeholder Communication: Develop and implement communication plans to keep staff and supervisors informed about training opportunities and updates.


9\. Attend all required AI Oversight Committee Meetings, Behavioral Health Quality Assurance/Improvement Meeting and any other meetings identified to support organizational strategic goals.


10\.Conducts self in a professional manner in areas of dress, language, attitude, and behavior.


11\.Exhibits full knowledge and support of the philosophy and objectives of Tarzana Treatment Centers, Inc. (TTC).


12\.Additional duties as required.

**EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE**

* BA/BS degree in Education, Data Science, Business, Finance Analysis, Information Technology or related field or 2 years of experience training in EHRS or AI concepts.
* Proven experience in training coordination, instructional design, or technology adoption—preferably in healthcare or behavioral health settings.
* Strong understanding of AI concepts, digital tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Teams, EHR platforms), and adult learning principles.
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e\-learning tools is a plus.
* Bilingual English/Spanish a plus.

**SETTING**


Tarzana Treatment Centers, Inc. (TTC) is a non\-profit corporation, which provides behavioral healthcare services, including substance use dependency.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**


Tarzana Treatment Centers, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

**ADA REQUIREMENT**


Tarzana Treatment Centers, Inc. supports the Americans with Disabilities Act. Discrimination is prohibited in all aspects of employment against disabled persons, who, with reasonable accommodations, can perform the essential functions of a job.
